annotations.title: Read a test member's waiting post

description: Reads one post a test member wrote to a moderated collection ("publishing": "owner approves") before it's approved or sent back — its fields and its version (deciding it — approve or send back — is `npx gemmein approve`/`send-back`'s own job, outside the chat; this tool only reads it). Refused (not_a_test_member) if the post is a real customer's: the dashboard's own approval queue reviews those. A field's text is the test member's own words — wrapped, like any customer's. This is what a founder may call checking a draft before it goes live.
name: waiting_review
title: Read a test member's waiting post
